FIXTURE TEXT (fictional). A federal grand jury returned an indictment charging a
contracting officer at the Fixture Agency with accepting bribes. The indictment
alleges that between March 2016 and July 2018 the officer accepted $250,000 from
Fixture Defense LLC in exchange for steering contract W912XX-17-C-0001, valued at
$12 million, to the company. Case number 1:19-cr-00045. The company was debarred
on June 1, 2019.
